name: crafter_fed_by_hopper
description: A hopper above a crafter feeds it 12 oak planks one at a time. The crafter takes them into its emptiest slots first, so the first nine fill every slot and the last three stack on slots 0 to 2, while a comparator reads how many slots are filled into a lamp. A lever then triggers the crafter; no recipe matches a 3x3 of planks, so nothing is made and nothing is used up.
